plugins.name: site-playbooks
plugins.description: Per-site usage-knowledge playbooks for browser-operating agents. Lookup finds the playbook for a URL's domain (most specific match wins) and prints its quirks, login flow, anti-bot notes, and selector strategy; add validates new playbooks; lint parses all. Seeded with github.com, generic-login, generic-captcha, google-search. Playbooks are community-contributed: verify before relying on them.
